seoTitle: How to Get a Manus AI Invitation Code (and Alternatives)
metaDescription: Get access to Manus AI through the official invitation process, plus a look at OpenManus as an alternative while you wait for your invite.
intro: Manus AI launched behind an invitation wall, and if you've filled out the request form and are still watching your inbox, the wait can feel indefinite. The good news is that the official process is faster than it looks, and there's a legitimate alternative worth trying in the meantime. This guide walks through the real request form, an open-source alternative called OpenManus, and — importantly — how to avoid the invitation code sellers who are cashing in on the wait.

steps.heading: Understand why Manus AI is invite-only
steps.body: Manus AI rolled out access gradually rather than opening sign-ups to everyone at once, which is common for AI tools managing server demand during a launch. That means there's no username-and-password signup flow to bypass — the only legitimate way in is through the request form, which puts you in a queue rather than granting instant access. Knowing this up front matters, because it's exactly the gap that invitation-code resellers exploit.

steps.heading: Submit the official request form
steps.body: Go to Manus AI's official site and fill out the access request: your email address and a short note on how you plan to use the tool. The form is short by design — it asks what you're using it for and your profession, then confirms it will send your invitation code to the email you provided. Based on user reports, approval has been landing in as little as three to five days rather than the long wait many people expect, so it's worth submitting this before chasing any workaround.

image.caption: The official Manus AI request form — enter your email and how you plan to use Manus, and an invitation code gets sent to that address.

steps.heading: Try OpenManus while you wait
steps.body: OpenManus, built by the MetaGPT team, is a separate open-source project available directly at openmanus.org with no invitation required. It's not Manus AI itself, but it aims to replicate similar agent-style functionality, which makes it a reasonable way to start experimenting with the same kind of workflow while your official request is pending. Treat it as a stand-in rather than a shortcut into Manus AI's own platform.

steps.heading: Keep an eye out for additional access portals
steps.body: Beyond OpenManus, a second alternative access route was still under testing at the time this guide was put together, without a confirmed public link yet. If you're actively hunting for alternatives, it's worth checking back on trustworthy sources rather than the first search result promising instant access, since that's where most of the scam links live.

steps.heading: Steer clear of paid invitation code sellers
steps.body: Multiple sites and individual sellers claim to sell Manus AI invitation codes for a fee — treat every one of them as fraudulent. A Reddit user documented receiving their official invitation email in just three days after signing up the normal way, which undercuts the entire premise that you need to pay someone for faster access. If a code is only available for money, that's the clearest signal to walk away.

faq.question: How long does it take to get an official Manus AI invitation?
faq.answer: Based on user reports, it can take around 3-5 days after signing up through the official request form — often faster than people expect.

faq.question: Is it safe to buy a Manus AI invitation code online?
faq.answer: No. Sites and sellers claiming to sell invitation codes are widely reported as fraudulent, and the legitimate wait is short enough that paying for a shortcut isn't worth the risk.

faq.question: What is OpenManus?
faq.answer: OpenManus is a separate, open-source alternative built by the MetaGPT team and accessible directly at openmanus.org, with functionality similar to Manus AI's agent approach but no invitation gate.

faq.question: What information does the Manus AI request form ask for?
faq.answer: Just your email address and a short explanation of how you intend to use Manus, plus your profession — Manus AI then emails the invitation code to that address once approved.

faq.question: Are there other alternative access portals besides OpenManus?
faq.answer: A second alternative was under testing at the time of this guide with no confirmed public link, so it's worth checking trustworthy sources for updates rather than trusting the first site that claims instant access.
